1.d4 f5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.O-.strategy: Puts the king behind the g2 bishop and the rook on f1. It finishes White's kingside development and prepares the fight for the centre with the c-pawn.

Black castles into the shelter of the fianchetto, completing the same safe set-up as White. The coming game is a fight over e4 and e5, with the f5 pawn holding one and the g7 bishop and a pawn aiming at the other.
